tools.name: get_datis

tools.name: get_datis_all

Maps to GET /api/datis/all. Phone-line transcripts are licensed for aviation use only. Commercial use requires a commercial licens

tools.description: Return airport info plus latest conditions, METAR, D-ATIS, and any ATIS or AWOS transcript from the past hour. This tool never starts a phone-line dial. tools.name: get_taf

Use get_runways, get_frequencies, or get_airport_remarks for a single nested table. Maps to GET /api/airport. Phone-line transcripts are licensed for aviation use only.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_aircraft_types" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
